tool.name: disassembler lexicmap
tool.description: tile LexicMap hits into a codon-checked cohort and collapsed haplotypes

param.name: infile
param.label: LexicMap search results
param.help: Output of LexicMap Search run with 'Output all columns' on, so the aligned sequences (qseq, sseq) are present. Each genome's hits must be on consecutive lines, as LexicMap writes them.

param.label: Reference CDS
param.help: The in-frame coding sequence that was searched. Only the first record is used; its length defines the coordinate grid every hit is projected onto.

param.label: Minimum coverage for the full-length cohort
param.help: Fraction of the reference an accession's merged hits must cover to enter the clean full-length cohort.

param.label: Minimum coverage for the partial cohort
param.help: Accessions between this and the full-length gate enter the clean partial cohort. Must not exceed the full-length gate.

param.label: Minimum percent identity per hit
param.help: Hits below this identity are dropped before coverage is computed.

param.label: Maximum premature stop codons
param.help: Accessions with more premature stops than this in the CDS body are flagged out of the clean cohort.

param.label: Require 100% coverage for the full-length cohort
param.help: Use complete coverage instead of the minimum coverage above as the full-length gate.

param.label: Keep frameshifted accessions in the clean cohort
param.help: Let accessions whose indels or frameshifts produce premature stops into the clean cohort anyway.

param.label: Representative accessions per haplotype
param.help: Maximum number of accessions listed for each collapsed haplotype in the haplotype table. Does not affect the FASTA outputs.

param.label: Stop after N input rows (preview)
param.help: Process at most N rows of the LexicMap tabular stream, then stop. Useful for sanity-checking the schema and reference choice against a very large tabular dataset before letting a full run go. Leave empty for the full stream.

param.label: Succeed even if the clean cohort is empty
param.help: By default the job fails when no accession passes the gates, so a whole-target miss is not mistaken for a good run.

data.name: clean_expanded_accessions
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: clean full-length and partial accessions

tool.help:
@HELP_SUITE@
-----
What it does ************
Turns LexicMap search hits of a reference CDS against Logan contigs into a codon-checked cohort of accessions and a table of collapsed haplotypes. This is the fast route: it never downloads unitigs. The trade-off is that a LexicMap hit is an alignment projected onto the reference, not a walked haplotype, so it does not recover intra-host variants. Use **disassembler walker** for those.
For each accession (subject genome) the tool:
1. drops hits below the identity floor, 2. tiles the remaining hits onto the reference coordinates, merging hits that each cover only part of the gene, 3. checks the tiled sequence for premature stop codons, 4. files the accession as clean full-length, clean partial, or flagged (premature stops or low coverage).
Clean full-length sequences are then collapsed into distinct haplotypes and annotated with their nucleotide and amino-acid changes against the reference.
-----
Inputs ******
- **LexicMap search results**: the tabular output of **LexicMap Search**, run with *Output all columns* on so the aligned sequences are present. Each genome's hits must sit on consecutive lines. LexicMap writes them that way. The tool stops with an error if a genome reappears later. - **Reference CDS**: the in-frame coding sequence that was searched.
-----
Outputs *******
- **Clean haplotype alignment**: the reference followed by one sequence per distinct clean haplotype, in reference coordinates. Headers carry counts and frequencies. This is already a reference-coordinate MSA: every row is the reference length, with no gaps and no Ns. Re-running MAFFT on it reproduces it byte-for-byte on strict clean-cohort output, so **disassembler msa** is a no-op on this file and only needs to run for parity with the walker route. - **Clean haplotype table**: per haplotype, its count, frequency, identity, mutations, mutation class and representative accessions. - **Clean full-length accessions**: one tiled sequence per clean full-length accession. In the same reference coordinates as the clean haplotype alignment, and ready for **disassembler sieve** (or **disassembler msa**, where the MAFFT pass is the same no-op). - **Clean full-length and partial accessions**: the same, including the partial tier. - **Flagged accessions** and **flagged accession table**: accessions excluded for premature stops or low coverage, with the reason. - **Cohort ledger**: one row per evaluated accession with its coverage, identity, status and tier. - **Summary**: cohort counts, coverage and identity distributions, and run statistics. - **Clean haplotype alignment (A2M)** (optional): the clean alignment in A2M format.
